name: Bodies
description: One victim, found dead on a London street. Four detectives, in four different time periods, must solve the mystery to protect Britain's future.

videos.title: 'You're Dead Already'
videos.overview: In 2023, Detective Hasan discovers a dead body in Longharvest Lane, Whitechapel — while in 1941 and 1890, two other detectives find the same corpse.

videos.title: 'Do You Know Who I Am?'
videos.overview: Hasan follows new leads in the present. As Hillinghead reluctantly closes his case, Whiteman goes to desperate lengths to hide involvement in his own.

videos.title: 'All In Good Time'
videos.overview: Connections between the cases start to come into focus. Whiteman encounters an unexpected complication; Hillinghead attends a séance.

videos.title: 'Right Up the Wazoo'
videos.overview: Hasan discovers she isn't the only detective investigating a murder on Longharvest Lane. In the past and future alike, relationships start to deepen.

videos.title: 'We Are One Another's Ghosts'
videos.overview: The past, present and future collide as a set of fingerprints from 1890 are found in 2023. Maplewood uncovers the Commander's true identity.

videos.title: 'The World Is Yours'
videos.overview: On the day of the explosion, Hasan does everything in her power to help Elias make a life-altering choice. The others wrestle with their consciences.

videos.title: 'Catch Me If You Can'
videos.overview: Elias finally knows what it means to be loved. He creates the family he's always wanted — but Hillinghead has to suffer for it.

videos.title: 'Know You Are Loved'
videos.overview: Across decades, the detectives work together to stop Elias from reshaping history. Will words be enough to break the loop and save thousands of lives?

awards: Nominated for 1 BAFTA Award2 wins & 6 nominations total
